rationale: Charlie's conviction that AI is expanding who can build software aligns with Ming's work on verifiable compute infrastructure — both are building foundational layers for a new wave of builders. Charlie's experience scaling developer platforms (React Native, Expo) across millions of developers complements Ming's expertise in cryptographic systems and zkVM architecture, offering potential insights on how verifiable compute could integrate into developer tooling and reach mainstream adoption.
intro_message: Charlie Cheever, meet Ming Guo — you're both building infrastructure for the next generation of software builders, and Charlie's experience scaling Expo to 3M+ developers could offer valuable perspective on how Ming's zkVM work reaches mainstream developer adoption.
